title: Typed WebAssembly capability routes
objective: Distinguish receipt-backed Wasm artifacts, shared runtime JavaScript, and portable fallbacks in browser parity requirements and receipts so route provenance cannot be laundered through a union of capability IDs

oracles: receipt-bound production artifact manifest plus reviewed capability report

handoff.summary: Browser parity requirements and receipts use exact typed routes with authenticated artifact, checked host-runtime, or checked portable-fallback provenance; the browser release stages the generated checked capability API and report.
risks: The full architecture aggregate needs a normal repository build in a fresh worktree before ffi:check can run.
next_steps: Integrate the companion compiler-runtime commit that publishes sagejs_capabilities in strict builtins and installs the checked API in Node.
